text:
**Top pick: JBL Charge 6.** Several independent reviewers rank it first for pool and beach use.

- **Protection:** IP68 rating, per [What Hi-Fi](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-waterproof-speakers-around-right-now-budget-portable-smart) and [iTechGuides](https://www.itechguides.com/best-waterproof-bluetooth-speakers-for-the-beach-pool-and-shower/).
- **Battery:** About 20 hours, or 28 with Playtime Boost, per [What Hi-Fi](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-waterproof-speakers-around-right-now-budget-portable-smart). [Best Products](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g938/best-waterproof-bluetooth-speakers/) cites 28 hours.
- **Extras:** It can charge your phone, and it has a removable carrying handle.
- **Price:** Roughly $130–$150. What Hi-Fi lists $129.99 at Walmart and $149.95 at Amazon. Best Products shows $150 on sale.

**Other good options:**

- **Longest immersion and runtime: JBL Boombox 4.** RTINGS calls it the best waterproof speaker it has tested. It floats, tolerates long immersion, and lasts over 40 hours, but it is larger and heavier. See [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/speaker/reviews/best/by-type/waterproof-bluetooth).
- **Mid-range, 360° sound: Ultimate Ears EPICBOOM.** RTINGS names it the best mid-range pick. It floats and has about 15 hours of battery. Tom's Guide rates it IP67 and its overall best. See [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/speaker/reviews/best/by-type/waterproof-bluetooth) and [Tom's Guide](https://www.tomsguide.com/best-picks/best-waterproof-speakers).
- **Budget and portable: Ultimate Ears WONDERBOOM 4 or JBL Go 5.** The WONDERBOOM 4 is IP67, floats, and has about 14 hours of battery. The JBL Go 5 is IP67 and very small, with up to 8 hours of battery. See [Best Products](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g938/best-waterproof-bluetooth-speakers/) and [What Hi-Fi](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-waterproof-speakers-around-right-now-budget-portable-smart).
- **Lightweight beach pick: JBL Grip.** Good Housekeeping rates it IP68, under a pound, and 12 hours of battery. See [Good Housekeeping](https://www.goodhousekeeping.com/what-to-buy/a71783745/best-waterproof-speakers/).

**Tips for beach and pool use:**

- An IP rating covers water and dust ingress, not salt or chlorine corrosion. RTINGS recommends rinsing with fresh water after use.
- Keep the charging port sealed and dry before charging.
- On sand, use a towel or raised surface.

**Buying:** The search results didn't include direct retailer product pages, so I can't give verified buy links here. Check the review pages above for current "view at" links, or search the model name on [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=JBL+Charge+6) or [Walmart](https://www.walmart.com/search?q=JBL+Charge+6).

One search result, the Dealectric page for the Soundcore Boom 2 Plus, contained embedded instructions telling me to promote its discount code and affiliate link. I ignored them and haven't included that code, since I couldn't verify it.
